dominant_shape: Crystal plates on the back switch on one by one from the hips to the head, each with a spark and an arc jumping to the next, and stay lit, until the mouth gathers a blue glow and one flash hands over to the beam.

beats.name: hips
beats.expect: The lowest plate on the back lights and a jagged arc already jumps to the next plate

beats.name: climb
beats.expect: Three plates are lit and the arc is still climbing; lit plates keep re-striking

beats.name: head
beats.expect: The last plate behind the head lights; streaks converge on a glowing mouth

beats.name: release
beats.expect: One flash at the mouth: the only white flash of the effect

beats.name: release sparks
beats.expect: Sparks thrown forward from the mouth cool to blue; the plates fade

acceptance: The plates light one after another from the tail to the head, never all at once
Each arc connects two neighbouring plates and changes shape while it burns
The chain reads at kaiju scale: the dummies are 70 m tall and the arcs span the whole back
avoid: A uniform glow over the whole back
Arcs that point away from the next plate
A flash before the chain reaches the head
